{
  "command": "replace_content_by_matching",
  "args": {
    "old_content": "\t// Direction state (Moore)
\tlocalparam logic STATE_LEFT  = 1'b0;
\tlocalparam logic STATE_RIGHT = 1'b1;

\tlogic dir_state;   // 0: walk left, 1: walk right
\tlogic falling;     // 1 when ground==0

\t// Initialize to known values to avoid X-propagation if needed
\tinitial begin
\t\tdir_state = STATE_LEFT;
\t\tfalling   = 1'b0;
\tend

\t// Async positive-edge reset
\talways @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
\t\tif (areset) begin
\t\t\tdir_state <= STATE_LEFT; // reset to walk left
\t\t\tfalling   <= 1'b0;
\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t// Falling flag always tracks ground
\t\t\tfalling <= ~ground;

\t\t\t// Update direction only when not falling (ground==1)
\t\t\tif (ground) begin
\t\t\t\t// If bumped on left => go right. If bumped on right => go left.
\t\t\t\t\t// If both => still switch directions (left becomes right when bump_left=1,
\t\t\t\t\t// right becomes left when bump_right=1). With both asserted, this implies
\t\t\t\t\tdir_state toggles.
\t\t\t\tcase ({bump_left, bump_right})
\t\t\t\t\t2'b10: dir_state <= STATE_RIGHT; // bumped_left
\t\t\t\t\t2'b01: dir_state <= STATE_LEFT;  // bumped_right
\t\t\t\t\t2'b11: dir_state <= ~dir_state; // both: switch
\t\t\t\t\t2'b00: dir_state <= dir_state;  // no bump
\t\t\t\tendcase
\t\t\tend
\t\tend
\tend

\t// Moore outputs derived from state/registers
\talways @(*) begin
\t\twalk_left  = (dir_state == STATE_LEFT);
\t\twalk_right = (dir_state == STATE_RIGHT);
\t\taaah       = falling;
\tend",
    "new_content": "\t// Moore FSM states
\tlocalparam logic ST_WALK_LEFT  = 2'b00;
\tlocalparam logic ST_WALK_RIGHT = 2'b01;
\tlocalparam logic ST_FALL_LEFT  = 2'b10;
\tlocalparam logic ST_FALL_RIGHT = 2'b11;

\tlogic [1:0] state;

\t// Initialize to known values
\tinitial begin
\t\tstate = ST_WALK_LEFT;
\tend

\t// Async positive-edge reset
\talways @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
\t\tif (areset) begin
\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_LEFT;
\t\tend else begin
\t\t\tcase (state)
\t\t\t\tST_WALK_LEFT: begin
\t\t\t\t\tif (!ground) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_FALL_LEFT;
\t\t\t\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t// bumps while on ground affect direction immediately
\t\t\t\t\t\tif (bump_right) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// bumped on right => walk left
\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_LEFT;
\t\t\t\t\t\tend else if (bump_left) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// bumped on left => walk right
\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_RIGHT;
\t\t\t\t\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_LEFT;
\t\t\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tST_WALK_RIGHT: begin
\t\t\t\t\tif (!ground) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_FALL_RIGHT;
\t\t\t\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t// bumps while on ground affect direction immediately
\t\t\t\t\t\tif (bump_left) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// bumped on left => walk right
\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_RIGHT;
\t\t\t\t\t\tend else if (bump_right) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// bumped on right => walk left
\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_LEFT;
\t\t\t\t\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_RIGHT;
\t\t\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tST_FALL_LEFT: begin
\t\t\t\t\t// while falling, direction is frozen
\t\t\t\t\tif (ground) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_LEFT;
\t\t\t\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_FALL_LEFT;
\t\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tST_FALL_RIGHT: begin
\t\t\t\t\t// while falling, direction is frozen
\t\t\t\t\tif (ground) begin
\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_WALK_RIGHT;
\t\t\t\t\tend else begin
\t\t\t\t\t\tstate <= ST_FALL_RIGHT;
\t\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\t\tend
\t\t\tendcase
\t\tend
\tend

\t// Moore outputs derived from FSM state
\talways @(*) begin
\t\twalk_left  = (state == ST_WALK_LEFT) ;
\t\twalk_right = (state == ST_WALK_RIGHT);
\t\taaah       = (state == ST_FALL_LEFT) || (state == ST_FALL_RIGHT);
\tend"
  }
}
